description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You or an ally within 15 feet is hit by an attack.

Reaction — a minor protective ward blunts one incoming attack.

Reduce the damage from the triggering attack by 2 plus your level. This is the Presence working, not a spell — it requires no components and cannot be counteracted.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 3/bucket 4 hybrid: a reaction that can target an ally. No rule element for a reactive flat damage reduction was found; Shield Block (the real analog) is hard-coded engine behavior, not a rule element, and doesn't cover allies at all.
